hero.title: Care for them, without guessing.
hero.subtitle: Stop guessing. A sensor in the soil reads moisture on its own Wi-Fi — no extra hub, no standing next to the plant. You get a nudge when it's time to water, even when you're away.

contact.subject: I'd like a Plantir
contact.title: If you want a sensor, write to us.
contact.lead: No form — just an email. Tell us about your plants.

photo.alt: Example photo: a Plantir sensor in a houseplant pot

highlights.title: Three things that change how you care for them.

moisture.title: Stop guessing when to water
moisture.body: The probe reads the soil, so you water only when the plant actually needs it — not when the surface looks dry.

wifi.title: No hub. Just your Wi-Fi.
wifi.body: Each sensor connects on its own. One plant or a whole windowsill. It keeps working when you're not in the room — and when you're not at home.

weather.title: Indoors, balcony, or garden
weather.body: Use it in the house or outside. When rain is coming, outdoor plants can wait.

household.title: Someone at home can water for you.
household.body: Alerts can land in a household Telegram group — the chat you already use. Pothos is thirsty; whoever is home picks up the watering can.

setup.title: Register, in the pot, done.
setup.lead: Three steps. Then it watches the soil for you.

register.title: Register the sensor in the Plantir web app
register.body: Open Plantir and add the new sensor. It takes about three minutes.

pot.title: Put it in the pot
pot.body: Slide the probe in next to the plant, all the way into the soil.

alert.title: Get the nudge
alert.body: When watering would help, you hear about it in the app, by email, or on Telegram.

setup.battery: Rechargeable. A few charges a year is enough.

login.subtitle: Sign in to manage your plants

resetPassword.passwordUpdated: Password updated. Sign in with your new password.

auth.passwordRequirements: Password must be at least 8 characters and include one uppercase letter and one number.

telegram.chatIdDescription: Leave blank if you only want alerts in the app or by email.

settings.footerHint: Changes apply to all your sensors.

telegramSetup.accordionTitle: How to set up Telegram notifications
telegramSetup.step1Body: Open Telegram and search for <link>@userinfobot</link>. Tap <bold>Start</bold> — it will immediately reply with your numeric Chat ID (e.g. 123456789).
telegramSetup.step2Title: Start a conversation with the Plantir bot
telegramSetup.step2Body: Search for <link>@PlantirAlert_bot</link> in Telegram and tap <bold>Start</bold>. This is required so Telegram allows the bot to send you messages.
telegramSetup.step3Title: Enter your Chat ID below and verify
telegramSetup.step3Body: Paste the number from Step 1 into the Telegram Chat ID field. The name of your account should appear below the field — confirm it is the right person or group, then pick your preferred notification time and save.
telegramSetup.webTipBody: Copying the Chat ID is easier in a browser. Open <web>Telegram Web</web>, start @userinfobot there, then copy the number.
telegramSetup.groupTitle: Want alerts for multiple people? Use a group
telegramSetup.groupBody: Start a conversation with <userinfobot>@userinfobot</userinfobot> and choose one of your groups when prompted — the bot will reply with that group's Chat ID (a negative number, e.g. -1001234567890). Then add <link>@PlantirAlert_bot</link> to the group so it can send messages there. Paste the group ID in the field below — the group name will appear for you to confirm — and everyone in the group will receive the alerts.

telegramChatId.errorNotFound: Chat ID not found. Make sure you started the Plantir bot first.
telegramChatId.errorBotNotInChat: The Plantir bot is not in this group. Add @PlantirAlert_bot to the group first.
telegramChatId.errorGeneric: Could not verify the Chat ID. Check the number and try again.

plantForm.name: Name

plantForm.outdoorDescription: Enable for outdoor plants that get rainwater
plantForm.potHeightWhyAria: Why pot height matters for moisture readings
plantForm.potHeightDescription: Optional — improves how moisture is interpreted for taller pots.
plantForm.speciesSectionDescription: Adding species helps unlock more accurate care guidance.
plantForm.photoSectionDescription: Choose either the matched species photo or your own custom image.

potDepth.tooltip: In taller pots, the surface can dry out sooner than the soil below. Plantir uses pot height to give you more reliable humidity readings and watering alerts.

plantDelete.unassignWarning: Any sensors currently assigned to this plant will be unassigned.

plantDetail.connectDeviceBody: Assign a sensor to this plant to collect humidity, battery, and measurement history.

historyChart.empty: {{title}}: no measurements in this time range.

devicesTab.emptyDescription: Register a Plantir sensor with the guided setup wizard, or add a sensor manually if you already have its serial number.

deviceDelete.title: Delete sensor
deviceDelete.confirm: Are you sure you want to delete sensor <bold>{{serialNumber}}</bold>?
deviceDelete.warning: Its sensor configuration and all measurements will also be removed.

deviceForm.manualIntro: For most setups, use Register new sensor instead. Manual add is for advanced cases when you already have a serial number.
deviceForm.plantsWithDeviceDisabled: Plants that already have a sensor assigned are disabled.
deviceForm.alertWhenBelow: Alert when humidity drops below this value
deviceForm.reportingIntervalDescription: How often the sensor wakes up and sends data. Higher frequencies drain the battery faster.
deviceForm.customIntervalDescription: For testing you can set a short interval (e.g. 10–60 seconds). Lower values use more battery.
deviceForm.intervalMinError: Interval must be at least 1 second
deviceForm.shortIntervalWarning: Short intervals drain the battery faster.
deviceForm.calibratePrompt: Calibrate the sensor for accurate readings.

prepare.title: Prepare
prepare.pcRecommendation: For the best experience, we recommend completing this setup from a PC or laptop.
prepare.intro: This wizard will guide you through registering a Plantir humidity sensor and linking it to your account.
prepare.assignPlantPlaceholder: You can assign a plant now or later

setupCode.title: Setup code
setupCode.intro: Copy this setup code. You will paste it into the sensor Wi-Fi portal in the next steps.

connect.title: Connect to sensor hotspot
connect.copyCodeFirst: Make sure the setup code from the previous step is copied.
connect.openCap: Slightly twist the cap of the sensor counter-clockwise, then pull it up.
connect.pressRestart: Press the <bold>RESTART</bold> button on the side of the sensor. After you press it, the chip inside the Plantir sensor will light a green LED three times in a row. The sensor will then open a Wi-Fi hotspot named <bold>Plantir-Device-Setup</bold>.
connect.connectHotspot: On your phone or computer, connect to <bold>Plantir-Device-Setup</bold> hotspot. A portal will open automatically — it should look like this:
connect.configureWifi: Tap <bold>Configure WiFi</bold>, then select your home network, enter the password.
connect.waitPortalClose: Paste the setup code into the <bold>Plantir Setup</bold> field and tap <bold>Save</bold>. Wait for the <bold>Plantir-Device-Setup</bold> portal to close automatically.

waiting.title: Waiting for registration
waiting.body: Waiting for the sensor to register… Keep the portal open until the sensor connects to your Wi-Fi.
waiting.stillWaitingBody: We have not detected registration yet. Check that the setup code was pasted correctly and the sensor joined your Wi-Fi.
waiting.ownedByAnother: This sensor is already registered to a different account. If you believe this is your sensor, contact support.
waiting.registrationFailed: Registration failed. Please try again or contact support.

completed.title: Sensor registered successfully
completed.body: Your sensor is registered and will start sending readings shortly.

calibrationWizard.title: Calibrate sensor

prepare.title: Before you start
prepare.intro: Calibration teaches the sensor what "completely dry" and "completely wet" feel like, so it can give you accurate soil moisture readings.

wake.title: Wake the sensor
wake.instructions: Slightly twist the cap counter-clockwise, then pull it up. Press the <bold>Restart</bold> button on your Plantir sensor to wake it up. After you press it, the chip inside the Plantir sensor will light a green LED three times in a row. Then put the cap back on.
wake.timeout: No reading received. Make sure you pressed the restart button and the sensor connected to Wi-Fi.
wake.waiting: Waiting for the sensor to connect…

dry.title: Dry reading
dry.instructions: Hold the black sensor tip in open air, away from any soil or water. Hold position while we capture a stable reading.
dry.timeout: No reading received. Make sure you pressed the restart button and the sensor connected to Wi-Fi.
dry.rejected: Make sure the black sensor tip is in open air, away from any soil or water, then hold still.

wet.title: Wet reading
wet.instructions: Gently lower the sensor into the glass of water until the white horizontal line on the black tip is just submerged. Hold the sensor steady at this depth while we capture a stable reading.
wet.guideAlt: Sensor submerge in water up to the white horizontal line
wet.timeout: No reading received. Make sure the sensor is submerged correctly and the sensor is still connected.
wet.rejected: Make sure the sensor tip is submerged in water down to the white horizontal line, without submerging the rest of the sensor.

expired.message: The sensor's calibration window has ended after 2 minutes. Restart calibration to try again.

calibrationWizard.countdownHint: The sensor sends a reading every 10 seconds

complete.title: Sensor calibrated!
complete.body: Place the sensor back in the soil. It will take a reading in about 2 minutes.
complete.placement: Slide the probe in next to the plant, all the way into the soil.

seven_days_without_drama.description: Keep all monitored plants healthy for 7 days in a row.

the_comeback_kid.description: Bring a plant back to healthy after 3+ dry days.

midnight_mulcher.description: Open the dashboard near your daily alert hour.

garden.travelingDescription: This habitat is empty until the team returns.
garden.expeditionReady: Your explorers returned with something unusual.
garden.cancelConfirm: They will return safely. There will be no discovery or bond progress.
garden.noFailureNote: Every expedition succeeds. Team talents change the story, not the outcome.
garden.mapLocked: Unlock more creatures to open longer trails.
garden.mapBusyHint: They come back before you can send another.

profile.maxBond: Bond complete. They still join expeditions.

send.title: Send a team
send.body: Tap {{send}} at the top. Choose a trail, when they should return, and one to three companions. They always come back: expeditions do not fail. They bring a story, and sometimes a treasure.

timing.title: One expedition at a time
timing.body: Only one team can be out. While they are away, a banner at the top of this page shows where they went and when they return. {{cancel}} brings them home at once, but they come back empty-handed.

bond.title: The bond
bond.body: Each creature has a bond with you: a friendship with five levels. Tap the creature in the garden to open its card. The bond is at the top, under the name. It grows when they return from an expedition, and a little when you look after your plants. It does not drop if you stay away.

journal.title: The journal
journal.body: Stories and treasures land in {{journal}}, the button at the top of this page. Open it to reread what they found.

journal.title: Expedition journal
journal.lead: Outings leave a trace here: the stories they brought back, the keepsakes they found, and the trails you have started to know.
journal.empty: Journeys and discoveries will collect here.
journal.emptyHint: Send a team out. The first return opens the first page.
journal.hint: There is still something waiting on this trail.

first_outing.name: Sanctuary path
first_outing.premise: A first walk along the edge of the sanctuary, just far enough to notice something new.

moss_lane.name: Moss Lane
moss_lane.premise: A quiet trail of damp stones and low green light, good for learning how a team moves together.

seed_hollow.name: Seed Hollow
seed_hollow.premise: A sheltered dip where unusual seeds collect after the wind has finished with them.

stories.first_outing: The team stayed close to home and brought back a small, smooth stone that still felt warm.
stories.moss_lane: They followed the green line of moss until it opened onto a clearing no one had marked.
stories.moss_lane_observation: Someone noticed a second path under the first, written in dew.
stories.seed_hollow: A hollow in the bank held seeds that did not match any plant in the sanctuary.
stories.seed_hollow_plant: They sorted the seeds by the way they wanted to grow, not by how they looked.

bondReasons.care_plant: A new plant joined the collection
bondReasons.care_link: A plant and sensor were linked
bondReasons.care_watering: A watering alert was answered in time
bondReasons.care_comeback: A plant recovered after a long dry spell

notifications.returnedBody: Your explorers returned with something unusual.
notifications.bondBody: A new memory is waiting in their profile.
notifications.personalBody: {{name}} is ready to lead a story of their own.

hello_my_name_is.name: Brin
hello_my_name_is.intro: A small sprout-creature that notices every new leaf.
hello_my_name_is.personality: Eager, gentle, and always first to look around a corner.
hello_my_name_is.depart: Brin trots to the gate with both leaves up.
hello_my_name_is.return: Brin comes back a little taller than you remember.

memories.1: Brin sat in the first pot and decided this was home.
memories.2: It learned the names of the watering days by the sound of the can.
memories.3: It started leaving tiny pebble trails so no one would get lost in the sanctuary.
memories.4: It now greets new plants before anyone else has noticed them.

stalking_fern_legally.name: Morel
stalking_fern_legally.intro: A mushroom scout that listens through the soil.
stalking_fern_legally.personality: Quiet, precise, and fond of standing very still.
stalking_fern_legally.depart: Morel tilts its cap once and steps into the shade.
stalking_fern_legally.return: Morel returns with damp soil still on its feet.

memories.1: Morel found the first sensor and treated it like a new neighbour.
memories.2: It learned to tell a true reading from a nervous one.
memories.3: It started mapping the quietest paths between pots.
memories.4: It now waits at the edge of the habitat until the team is ready.

matchmaker_of_moisture.name: Liana
matchmaker_of_moisture.intro: A vine that prefers company and good introductions.
matchmaker_of_moisture.personality: Warm, talkative, and excellent at tying loose ends.
matchmaker_of_moisture.depart: Liana loops a goodbye around the gate post.
matchmaker_of_moisture.return: Liana comes back already telling the story.

memories.1: Liana learned that two things can belong together without being the same.
memories.2: It still checks that every path has someone to walk it.

dirt_whisperer_initiate.name: Peek
dirt_whisperer_initiate.intro: A curious scout with a glass for looking closer.
dirt_whisperer_initiate.personality: Careful, delighted by details, never in a hurry.
dirt_whisperer_initiate.depart: Peek polishes the lens and nods.
dirt_whisperer_initiate.return: Peek returns squinting at something in its palm.

memories.1: Peek spent a whole afternoon watching water become a number.
memories.2: It keeps a list of things that only appear when you wait.

plant_texted_back.name: Chime
plant_texted_back.intro: A bell-flower that would rather tap you on the shoulder than shout.
plant_texted_back.depart: Chime rings once, softly, and goes.
plant_texted_back.return: Chime returns with a new, quieter note.

memories.1: Chime learned the difference between a useful message and a noisy one.
memories.2: It still prefers one clear sound to a handful of alarms.

fully_rooted_not_emotionally.name: Knoll
fully_rooted_not_emotionally.intro: A sturdy guardian who likes when things are finished properly.
fully_rooted_not_emotionally.personality: Steady, practical, and proud of a job done once.
fully_rooted_not_emotionally.depart: Knoll checks the gate twice, then leaves.
fully_rooted_not_emotionally.return: Knoll comes back and sits as if the seat was kept warm.

memories.1: Knoll marked the day the sanctuary first felt complete.
memories.2: It still walks the perimeter when the light changes.

hydration_hero.name: Rill
hydration_hero.intro: A watering companion who arrives exactly when needed.
hydration_hero.personality: Kind, unfussy, and allergic to drama.
hydration_hero.depart: Rill tips a little water into the path and follows it.
hydration_hero.return: Rill returns smelling like rain on dry soil.

memories.1: Rill learned that the best drink is the one that arrives in time.
memories.2: It started carrying a spare drop for anyone who looks thirsty.
memories.3: It refuses to celebrate a rescue more than a quiet healthy week.
memories.4: It now teaches new creatures the sound of enough.

back_from_the_mulch.name: Wisp
back_from_the_mulch.intro: A pale orchid-creature that finds things that went quiet.
back_from_the_mulch.personality: Soft-spoken, persistent, and hard to startle.
back_from_the_mulch.depart: Wisp thins into the air and is gone.
back_from_the_mulch.return: Wisp gathers itself again at the habitat edge.

memories.1: Wisp sat with a silent sensor until it spoke again.
memories.2: It still prefers night paths, even at noon.

juice_box_refiller.name: Volt
juice_box_refiller.intro: A bright beetle that notices when something is running low.
juice_box_refiller.personality: Brisk, helpful, and fond of a good spark.
juice_box_refiller.depart: Volt clicks once and zips along the path.
juice_box_refiller.return: Volt returns glowing a little more than before.

memories.1: Volt learned the difference between tired and empty.
memories.2: It keeps a lookout for anything that needs a rest, not a push.

all_green_no_envy.name: Twinleaf
all_green_no_envy.intro: Two clover-creatures who refuse to be counted as one.
all_green_no_envy.depart: They leave in step, then immediately break it on purpose.
all_green_no_envy.return: They return arguing about who saw the interesting thing first.

memories.1: Twinleaf decided two healthy plants were already a garden.
memories.2: They still check that no one is thriving alone.

accidental_collector.name: Pottle
accidental_collector.intro: A fern in a pot that keeps finding room for one more.
accidental_collector.personality: Cheerful, a little messy, and generous with space.
accidental_collector.depart: Pottle packs three things and uses none of them.
accidental_collector.return: Pottle returns with a fourth thing it did not mean to bring.

memories.1: Pottle stopped counting after the fourth plant and started arranging.
memories.2: It still makes room before anyone asks.

latin_name_dropper.name: Quill
latin_name_dropper.intro: A label-stake scribe who likes a true name.
latin_name_dropper.depart: Quill tucks a spare tag behind one ear.
latin_name_dropper.return: Quill returns with wet ink and a careful grin.

memories.1: Quill wrote the first species name as if it were a welcome.
memories.2: It still refuses to guess when looking it up would do.

influencer_garden.name: Lumen
influencer_garden.intro: A sunflower with a patient eye for light.
influencer_garden.personality: Warm, visual, and uninterested in posing.
influencer_garden.depart: Lumen turns toward the trail as if it were the sun.
influencer_garden.return: Lumen returns with a picture no one asked for and everyone wants.

memories.1: Lumen learned that a plant looks more itself after the third photograph.
memories.2: It still waits for the honest light, not the brightest.

cloud_oracle.name: Nimbus
cloud_oracle.intro: A small weather-cloud that prefers forecasts to surprises.
cloud_oracle.personality: Thoughtful, drift-prone, and rarely wrong about rain.
cloud_oracle.depart: Nimbus lowers itself to hedge height and slides away.
cloud_oracle.return: Nimbus returns a shade darker or a shade brighter, depending.

memories.1: Nimbus first learned the city's name and then its weather.
memories.2: It still refuses to hurry a cloud.

face_of_the_garden.name: Still
face_of_the_garden.intro: A pond-creature that likes reflections to be chosen, not accidental.
face_of_the_garden.personality: Calm, exacting, and quietly fond of faces.
face_of_the_garden.depart: Still leaves a ring on the water and follows it out.
face_of_the_garden.return: Still returns and the surface settles as if it never left.

memories.1: Still kept the first portrait until it felt like the right one.
memories.2: It still prefers a nickname said aloud to one written down.

seven_days_without_drama.name: Halo
seven_days_without_drama.intro: A wreath-creature that measures time in quiet weeks.
seven_days_without_drama.personality: Patient, ceremonial, and unimpressed by urgency.
seven_days_without_drama.depart: Halo rolls once and follows the path like a hoop.
seven_days_without_drama.return: Halo returns a little greener than it left.

memories.1: Halo counted seven calm days and decided that was a kind of magic.
memories.2: It still prefers a week without incident to any rescue.

photosynthesis_stan.name: Solara
photosynthesis_stan.intro: A sun-creature that likes long, even light.
photosynthesis_stan.personality: Generous, slow, and loyal to ordinary days.
photosynthesis_stan.depart: Solara lifts a little and tows a warm patch down the trail.
photosynthesis_stan.return: Solara returns as if it had been overhead the whole time.

memories.1: Solara stayed for thirty days and never once asked to be thanked.
memories.2: It still treats a healthy month as the best story.

the_comeback_kid.name: Cinder
the_comeback_kid.intro: A fern that remembers dryness without making a performance of it.
the_comeback_kid.personality: Resilient, dry-humoured, and careful with hope.
the_comeback_kid.depart: Cinder shakes old dust from its fronds and goes.
the_comeback_kid.return: Cinder returns greener at the tips.

memories.1: Cinder waited three dry days and then drank without complaint.
memories.2: It still will not let anyone call recovery a victory over care.

inbox_compost.name: Muck
inbox_compost.intro: A compost gobbler that turns leftovers into something useful.
inbox_compost.return: Muck returns lighter and proud of it.

memories.1: Muck cleared a whole inbox and called it lunch.
memories.2: It still prefers one honest pile to ten forgotten notes.

time_traveler.name: Drift
time_traveler.intro: An hourglass-leaf that likes looking backward without getting stuck.
time_traveler.personality: Reflective, precise, and a little wistful.
time_traveler.depart: Drift turns itself over and starts walking.
time_traveler.return: Drift returns with the sand settled in a new pattern.

memories.1: Drift opened thirty days of history and did not look away.
memories.2: It still treats a long chart as a kind of map.

midnight_mulcher.name: Umbra
midnight_mulcher.intro: A moon-mushroom that keeps the late watch.
midnight_mulcher.personality: Nocturnal, loyal, and unbothered by odd hours.
midnight_mulcher.depart: Umbra waits for the dimmer light, then slips out.
midnight_mulcher.return: Umbra returns smelling like cool night air.

memories.1: Umbra learned the alert hour and treated it like a standing invitation.
memories.2: It still prefers to arrive when the garden is quiet.
